what: review-accepted: the acceptance record is the review page's Accept hand-off for the spec at the registered commit, read by octo-feather-accepted from every session's registry rows and their spools.
why: Nothing writes the registry's accepted registration the spec named, so the owner's Accept was never recorded (PR #56, owner approved 2026-10-20).
evidence: Pilot 1 (2026-10-20): Tom pressed Accept spec, the page wrote its hand-off, and octo-feather-accepted still exited 1 waiting for a registry accepted = true that nothing writes; the agent hand-wrote it twice.

what: LINEAR_API_KEY comes only from the environment, herdr-spawn passes it into panes, nothing stores or logs it and the qc judge runs without it; just install-check checks the linear CLI for a Linear target. Adds acceptance-linear-key-panes, -qc, acceptance-install-linear, story-tracker-key and story-tracker-tools.
why: Owner ruling (2026-10-22, issue #82): the kit works with Linear directly so it can run on a Linear-first repository; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says a toolchain of 'git, gh, jq, just, python3, uv, node, pnpm, Herdr and Pi' and no tracker key (host-tools); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target.

what: The linear CLI on the box is schpet/linear-cli at the release the vendored skill is pinned to (v3.1.0), from its release binary or npx @schpet/linear-cli, authenticated by LINEAR_API_KEY; the install check names the pinned version and how to install it.
why: Owner direction (2026-10-22, issue #82, before Accept): schpet/linear-cli (ISC, release v3.1.0), the CLI octo-lite uses, ships its own agent skill; vendor it and keep the kit's linear tracker skill to the seven fixed scripts as thin CLI wrappers.
evidence: host-tools pointed install to 'the linear skill's install notes', which the linear skill no longer holds (skills local-linear: only the tracker scripts), while the vendored linear-cli SKILL.md gives the install path: 'npx @schpet/linear-cli' or the release install.
